name: screenless
description: Review your agents' overnight pull requests by phone, before you open a laptop

scripts.bundle: npm run build && COPYFILE_DISABLE=1 tar -czf ../site/public/screenless.tar.gz -C dist --exclude='*.map' . && cp ../loop/SKILL.md ../site/public/SKILL.md && cp ../loop/APPLY.md ../site/public/APPLY.md && cp ../loop/nightly.sh ../site/public/nightly.sh && cp ../loop/collect.sh ../site/public/collect.sh
